geometry.scope: Nominal coaxial spherical/plane solids, declared full OD, sampled configured-field/spectrum ray envelope and supplied scalar loss budgets.
limitations: No tilted/decentred elements, aspheres, stepped edges, flange or truncated spherical solids.
Ray coverage is the stated finite field/wavelength/pupil sampling, not a continuous-domain bound.
Mounts, spacers, insertion, bevel/support contact geometry, tooling, stress, coatings and manufacturing yield require separate evidence.
sources: Positive cap thickness and 0.45 mm clear-to-finished rim allowance.

method.geometry: analytic spherical monotonic extrema and complete cap nearest-point candidate enumeration
method.ray_envelope: Optiwork actual physical launcher and native refractive trace including exact pupil rim
